京西路 is the Jingxi circuit, not a western capital circuit; the literal field has the same error.

Before he could depart, Hebei ran short of military funds and he was selected as chief transport commissioner. Promoted to Langzhong in the Ministry of Works, he supplied the needed funds without increasing levies on the people.
都轉運使 is chief transport commissioner, not metropolitan; the literal field has the same error.

His son-in-law Su Shunchin, a young man skilled in writing whose opinions sometimes affronted powerful families, oversaw the Memorial Submission Office and, following precedent, entertained guests with music at a temple sacrifice. Wang Yirou, a collator in the Hall for Assembling Worthies whom Yan knew, was reported to have mockingly composed A Song of Arrogance. The censors all impeached the matter, hoping thereby to imperil Yan.

Wang Yirou, a collator in the Hall for Assembling Worthies whom Yan knew, was reported to have mockingly composed A Song of Arrogance. The censors all impeached the matter, hoping thereby to imperil Yan.
蘇舜欽 is romanized Su Shunqin; the literal field has the same error.

請屬吏 means requesting that Ding Du be handed to the officials for investigation, not that he asked to assign subordinates; the literal field has the same error.

In the first year of Huangyou he was specially promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and summoned to accompany the Bright Hall sacrifice. 太子太保 is Grand Guardian, not Grand Preceptor (太師); the literal field has the same error.

He was posthumously granted the titles of Minister of Education and Concurrent Palace Attendant, with the posthumous title "Upright Contribution."

王曾 is romanized Wang Zeng, not Wang Ceng; the literal field has the same error.
Di and Ceng spoke with stern countenance and dire warning, so that eunuchs and close attendants did not dare to covet power;
Di and Zeng spoke with stern countenance and dire warning, so that eunuchs and close attendants did not dare to covet power;
曾 here is Wang Zeng, romanized Zeng, not Ceng; the literal field has the same error.
